capabilities: Share a note or folder through an HTTP server inside the Obsidian desktop app
Serve shared content through a responsive folder index
Protect shared URLs with an optional secret token
Track anonymous local page views and unique visitors without storing IP addresses
Customize theme, accent color, fonts, and custom CSS of shared pages
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory (submission in preparation); manual installation instructions provided. README warns that local HTTP traffic is unencrypted and should not be used on untrusted or public networks.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to let other devices on a local network read selected notes without uploading them to a cloud service.
summary: Local-network server that shares selected notes or folders as read-only web pages to devices on the same private network.
